name: Magnus the Physician
bio: Magnus the Physician is one of the named epigrammatists of the Greek Anthology. Paton’s Index of Authors dates him, with a query, to the 4th century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 270.

poems.title: Book XVI, 270: On a Portrait of Galen
poems.author: Magnus the Physician
poems.text: There was a time, Galen, when, owing to thee, Earth received men mortal and reared them in immortality. The halls of tearful Acheron were bereaved by the force of thy healing hand.
